Category.Name: PENALTIES
Category._:
FOR NRTOPTRO TYPE FARES
 
  CHANGES
 
    CHARGE EUR 20.00.
         NOTE -
          A CHANGE IS A DATE/FLIGHT/ROUTING/RBD MODIFICATION
          --------------------------------------------------
          CHANGE FEE/CP -
          TRANSACTION MADE -
          1.BEFORE THE DAY OF DEPARTURE OF THE ORIGINALLY
          SCHEDULED FLIGHT - EUR10.00
          2.ON/AFTER THE DAY OF DEPARTURE OF THE ORIGINALLY
          SCHEDULED FLIGHT - EUR20.00 /ALSO FOR NO-SHOW-
          EUR20.00/
          TRANSACTION IS VALIDATED AGAINST THE TICKET
          COUPON/S BEING CHANGED.
          --------------------------------------------------
          WHEN MORE THAN ONE FARE COMPONENT IS BEING
          CHANGED - THE HIGHEST FEE OF ALL CHANGED FARE
          COMPONENTS PER TICKET WILL APPLY.
          NO FEE DISCOUNT APPLIES TO CHILD/INFANT WITH A
          SEAT. NO FEE APPLIES TO INFANT WITHOUT A SEAT.
          FEE WILL APPLY PER PASSENGER/FOR EACH TRANSACTION.
          FEE WILL BE SELECTED IN THE CURRENCY OF THE
          COUNTRY OF PRICING UNIT ORIGIN WHEN FILED IN THAT
          CURRENCY AND WILL BE CONVERTED INTO THE CURRENCY
          OF PAYMENT AT THE CURRENT BSR RATE.
          --------------------------------------------------
          RE-PRICE THE NEW ITINERARY FROM THE POINT OF
          ORIGIN USING RO FARES IN THE SAME OR A HIGHER RBD.
          PUBLIC OR PRIVATE FARES MAY BE USED.
          THE FARE BEING APPLIED MUST COMPLY WITH ALL
          PROVISIONS.
          --------------------------------------------------
          WHEN NO INTERNATIONAL COUPONS REMAIN ALL NEW
          TRAVEL MUST BE DOMESTIC.
          --------------------------------------------------
          CHANGES TO FARE BREAK POINTS ARE PERMITTED.
          A FULLY FLOWN FARE COMPONENT MAY NOT BE RE-PRICED
          TO A FURTHER POINT.
          --------------------------------------------------
          THE REPLACEMENT FARE MUST BE EQUAL OR HIGHER THAN
          PREVIOUS/PER TICKET. IT MAY BE LOWER/EQUAL OR
          HIGHER ONLY WHEN CHANGES ARE MADE TO A FULLY
          UNUSED TICKET AND THE RBD/CONNECTION/STOPOVER AND
          FARE BREAK POINTS ARE KEPT AS ORIGINALLY TICKETED.
          ANY DIFFERENCE WILL BE COLLECTED.
          ANY RESIDUAL FARE AMOUNT WILL BE IGNORED.
          THE APPLICABLE CHANGE FEE/CP WILL BE CHARGED IN
          ADDITION.
          --------------------------------------------------
          1.WHEN CHANGES ARE MADE TO A FULLY UNUSED TICKET-
          RE-PRICE USING THE CURRENT FARES IN EFFECT ON THE
          DATE OF THE TRANSACTION. IF CHANGES DO NOT OCCUR
          ON THE 1ST FARE COMPONENT OF THE JOURNEY ALSO
          RE-PRICE USING HISTORICAL FARES AND SELECT
          WHICHEVER IS LOWER.
          2.WHEN CHANGES ARE MADE TO A PARTIALLY USED TICKET
          RE-PRICE USING THE HISTORICAL FARES IN EFFECT ON
          THE DATE OF THE PREVIOUS ISSUE.
          --------------------------------------------------
          THE ORIGINAL NONREFUNDABLE AMOUNT FROM A PREVIOUS
          TICKET SHALL BE CARRIED FORWARD AS NONREFUNDABLE
          TO ANY EXCHANGED/REISSUED TICKET.
 
  AND - CANCELLATIONS
 
    CHARGE 75 PERCENT.
         NOTE -
          CANCELLATION RULES APPLY PER FARE COMPONENT.
          --------------------------------------------------
          CANCELLATION FEE -
          TRANSACTION MADE -
          1.BEFORE THE DAY OF DEPARTURE OF THE ORIGINALLY
          SCHEDULED FLIGHT - 50PERCENT PER COUPON
          2.ON/AFTER THE DAY OF DEPARTURE OF THE ORIGINALLY
          SCHEDULED FLIGHT - 75PERCENT PER COUPON/ ALSO FOR
          NO-SHOW- 75PERCENT PER COUPON/
          TRANSACTION IS VALIDATED AGAINST THE TICKET
          COUPON/S BEING CANCELLED.
          ---------------------------------------------
          CANCELLATION FEE APPLIES PER EACH CANCELLED FARE
          COMPONENT. THE SUM OF THE CANCELLATION FEES OF
          ALL CANCELLED FARE COMPONENTS WILL BE CHARGED.
          NO FEE DISCOUNT APPLIES TO CHILD/INFANT WITH A
          SEAT. NO FEE APPLIES TO INFANT WITHOUT A SEAT.
          FEE WILL BE SELECTED IN THE CURRENCY OF THE
          COUNTRY OF PRICING UNIT ORIGIN WHEN FILED IN THAT
          CURRENCY AND WILL BE CONVERTED INTO THE CURRENCY
          OF PAYMENT AT THE CURRENT BSR RATE.
          --------------------------------------------------
          FOR A PARTIALLY USED TICKET CALCULATE THE
          DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THE FARE PAID AND THE
          APPLICABLE FARE FOR THE PORTION FLOWN RE-ASSESSED
          ON THE DATE OF THE ORIGINAL ISSUE IN THE SAME OR
          HIGHER RBD/S. UNLESS THE FARE IS NONREFUNDABLE ANY
          CREDIT WILL BE REFUNDED/LESS THE CANCELLATION
          FEE/S IF APPLICABLE.
          --------------------------------------------------
          WHEN RE-PRICING THE FLOWN PORTION -
          THE FARE SELECTED SHALL BE EQUAL TO OR HIGHER
          THAN THE ORIGINAL FARE. THE FARE BREAK POINTS MAY
          NOT BE CHANGED FOR A FULLY FLOWN FARE COMPONENT.
          A FLOWN PORTION AT PUBLIC FARES CAN BE RE-PRICED
          ONLY WITH PUBLIC FARES.
          A FLOWN PORTION AT PRIVATE FARE CAN BE RE-PRICED
          WITH PUBLIC OR QUALIFIED PRIVATE FARES.
          --------------------------------------------------
          WHEN COMBINING DIFFERENT FARES THE PROVISIONS
          WILL APPLY AS FOLLOWS-
          1.THE AMOUNT PAID ON THE NONREFUNDABLE FARE
          COMPONENT WILL NOT BE REFUNDED.
          2.THE AMOUNT PAID ON THE REFUNDABLE FARE
          COMPONENT WILL BE REFUNDED/LESS THE CANCELLATION
          FEE IF APPLICABLE.
          3.THE SUM OF THE CANCELLATION FEES OF ALL
          CANCELLED FARE COMPONENTS WILL BE CHARGED.
          --------------------------------------------------
          THE ORIGINAL NONREFUNDABLE AMOUNT FROM A PREVIOUS
          TICKET SHALL BE CARRIED FORWARD AS NONREFUNDABLE
          TO ANY EXCHANGED/REISSUED TICKET.
          WHERE THE NONREFUNDABLE AMOUNT CARRIED FORWARD
          FROM A PREVIOUS TICKET IS HIGHER THAN THAT BASED
          ON THE PROVISIONS OF THE NEWLY EXCHANGED/REISSUED
          TICKET THAT DIFFERENCE SHALL BE ADDED TO THE
          APPLICABLE CANCELLATION FEE TO BE TAKEN.
          ANY ORIGINAL NONREFUNDABLE TAX AMOUNT CARRIED
          FORWARD WILL NOT BE REFUNDED.
          --------------------------------------------------
          CANCELLATION FEE IS CAPPED UP TO THE REFUNDABLE
          AMOUNT CALCULATED FOR THE FARE PLUS THE
          REFUNDABLE YQ/YR SURCHARGE/S.
    AND -
         NOTE -
          --------------------------------------------------
          TRANSACTIONS ARE ALLOWED WITHIN THE TICKET
          VALIDITY.
          --------------------------------------------------
          CHANGE FEE/S SHALL BE COLLECTED UNDER CP CODE IN
          THE TAX BOX.
          --------------------------------------------------
          TAXES/FEES CONDITIONS-
          1.UNUSED AIRPORT TAXES/ TAXES PAID TO THIRD
          PARTIES MAY BE REFUNDED UNLESS THEY ARE LEGALLY
          NON-REFUNDABLE.
          2.UNUSED YQ/YR CARRIER SURCHARGE/S CANNOT BE
          REFUNDED UNLESS THE FARE IS REFUNDABLE.
          THE REFUNDABLE YQ/YR AMOUNT SHALL BE USED TO
          COVER THE CANCELLATION FEE/S/ IF APPLICABLE.
          UNUSED YQ/YR CARRIER SURCHARGE/S MAY BE REUSED.
          3.AIRLINE SERVICE OB/TS FEE/S CANNOT BE REFUNDED
          UNLESS THERE IS AN INVOLUNTARY REQUEST FOR A
          COMPLETELY UNUSED TICKET.
          4.CP CHANGE FEE/S CANNOT BE REFUNDED OR REUSED.
          -------------------------------------------------
          WAIVERS ----
          1.AUTHORISED BEFORE DEPARTURE IN CASE OF
          REJECTION OF VISA - THE EMBASSY STATEMENT
          REQUIRED.
          2.AUTHORISED IN THE EVENT OF THE DEATH OF THE
          PASSENGER OR FAMILY MEMBER - THE DEATH
          CERTIFICATE REQUIRED.
  *** GENERAL RULE FOLLOWS ***
 
 
         NOTE -
          --------------------------------------------------
          TRANSACTIONS ARE ALLOWED WITHIN THE TICKET
          VALIDITY.
          --------------------------------------------------
          CHANGE FEE SHALL BE COLLECTED UNDER CP CODE IN
          THE TAX BOX.
          --------------------------------------------------
          TAXES/FEES CONDITIONS-
          1.UNUSED AIRPORT TAXES/ TAXES PAID TO THIRD
          PARTIES MAY BE REFUNDED UNLESS THEY ARE LEGALLY
          NON-REFUNDABLE.
          2.UNUSED YQ/YR CARRIER IMPOSED SURCHARGE/S CANNOT
          BE REFUNDED UNLESS THE FARE IS REFUNDABLE/ WITH OR
          WITHOUT FEE/S/.
          THE REFUNDABLE YQ/YR AMOUNT SHALL BE USED TO
          COVER THE CANCELLATION FEE/S/ IF APPLICABLE.
          UNUSED YQ/YR CARRIER SURCHARGE/S MAY BE REUSED.
          3.AIRLINE SERVICE OB/TS FEE/S CANNOT BE REFUNDED
          UNLESS THERE IS AN INVOLUNTARY REQUEST FOR A
          COMPLETELY UNUSED TICKET.
          4.CP CHANGE FEE/S CANNOT BE REFUNDED OR REUSED.
          -------------------------------------------------
          WAIVERS ----
          1.AUTHORISED BEFORE DEPARTURE IN CASE OF
          REJECTION OF VISA - THE EMBASSY STATEMENT
          REQUIRED.
          2.AUTHORISED IN THE EVENT OF THE DEATH OF THE
          PASSENGER OR FAMILY MEMBER - THE DEATH
          CERTIFICATE REQUIRED.

Category.Name: COMBINATIONS
Category._:
DOUBLE OPEN JAWS/CIRCLE TRIPS NOT PERMITTED.
   APPLICABLE ADD-ON CONSTRUCTION IS ADDRESSED IN
   MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS - CATEGORY 23.
  END-ON-END
    END-ON-END COMBINATIONS PERMITTED. VALIDATE ALL FARE
    COMPONENTS. ROUND TRIP EXCURSION FARES MAY NOT BE
    COMBINED END-ON-END WITH ANY ONE WAY OR ROUND TRIP FARE
    WHEN THESE FARES HAVE OVERLAPPING TRAVEL PERIODS AND ARE
    TO/FROM THE SAME CITIES OF ORIGIN AND DESTINATION AS A
    STOPOVER OR FARE BREAK POINT. SIDE TRIPS PERMITTED.
  OPEN JAWS/ROUND TRIPS
    FARES MAY BE COMBINED ON A HALF ROUND TRIP BASIS WITH RO
    FARES
    -TO FORM SINGLE OPEN JAWS.
     MILEAGE OF THE OPEN SEGMENT MUST BE EQUAL/LESS THAN
     MILEAGE OF THE SHORTEST FLOWN FARE COMPONENT.
    -TO FORM ROUND TRIPS
   PROVIDED -
     COMBINATIONS ARE WITH ANY FARE IN RULE SP02 IN TARIFF
      IPREURD - WITHIN EUROPE-DOMESTIC.

Category.Name: PENALTIES
Category._:
FOR NRTOPTRO TYPE FARES
 
  CHANGES
 
    CHARGE EUR 20.00.
         NOTE -
          A CHANGE IS A DATE/FLIGHT/ROUTING/RBD MODIFICATION
          --------------------------------------------------
          CHANGE FEE/CP -
          TRANSACTION MADE -
          1.BEFORE THE DAY OF DEPARTURE OF THE ORIGINALLY
          SCHEDULED FLIGHT - EUR10.00
          2.ON/AFTER THE DAY OF DEPARTURE OF THE ORIGINALLY
          SCHEDULED FLIGHT - EUR20.00 /ALSO FOR NO-SHOW-
          EUR20.00/
          TRANSACTION IS VALIDATED AGAINST THE TICKET
          COUPON/S BEING CHANGED.
          --------------------------------------------------
          WHEN MORE THAN ONE FARE COMPONENT IS BEING
          CHANGED - THE HIGHEST FEE OF ALL CHANGED FARE
          COMPONENTS PER TICKET WILL APPLY.
          NO FEE DISCOUNT APPLIES TO CHILD/INFANT WITH A
          SEAT. NO FEE APPLIES TO INFANT WITHOUT A SEAT.
          FEE WILL APPLY PER PASSENGER/FOR EACH TRANSACTION.
          FEE WILL BE SELECTED IN THE CURRENCY OF THE
          COUNTRY OF PRICING UNIT ORIGIN WHEN FILED IN THAT
          CURRENCY AND WILL BE CONVERTED INTO THE CURRENCY
          OF PAYMENT AT THE CURRENT BSR RATE.
          --------------------------------------------------
          RE-PRICE THE NEW ITINERARY FROM THE POINT OF
          ORIGIN USING RO FARES IN THE SAME OR A HIGHER RBD.
          PUBLIC OR PRIVATE FARES MAY BE USED.
          THE FARE BEING APPLIED MUST COMPLY WITH ALL
          PROVISIONS.
          --------------------------------------------------
          WHEN NO INTERNATIONAL COUPONS REMAIN ALL NEW
          TRAVEL MUST BE DOMESTIC.
          --------------------------------------------------
          CHANGES TO FARE BREAK POINTS ARE PERMITTED.
          A FULLY FLOWN FARE COMPONENT MAY NOT BE RE-PRICED
          TO A FURTHER POINT.
          --------------------------------------------------
          THE REPLACEMENT FARE MUST BE EQUAL OR HIGHER THAN
          PREVIOUS/PER TICKET. IT MAY BE LOWER/EQUAL OR
          HIGHER ONLY WHEN CHANGES ARE MADE TO A FULLY
          UNUSED TICKET AND THE RBD/CONNECTION/STOPOVER AND
          FARE BREAK POINTS ARE KEPT AS ORIGINALLY TICKETED.
          ANY DIFFERENCE WILL BE COLLECTED.
          ANY RESIDUAL FARE AMOUNT WILL BE IGNORED.
          THE APPLICABLE CHANGE FEE/CP WILL BE CHARGED IN
          ADDITION.
          --------------------------------------------------
          1.WHEN CHANGES ARE MADE TO A FULLY UNUSED TICKET-
          RE-PRICE USING THE CURRENT FARES IN EFFECT ON THE
          DATE OF THE TRANSACTION. IF CHANGES DO NOT OCCUR
          ON THE 1ST FARE COMPONENT OF THE JOURNEY ALSO
          RE-PRICE USING HISTORICAL FARES AND SELECT
          WHICHEVER IS LOWER.
          2.WHEN CHANGES ARE MADE TO A PARTIALLY USED TICKET
          RE-PRICE USING THE HISTORICAL FARES IN EFFECT ON
          THE DATE OF THE PREVIOUS ISSUE.
          --------------------------------------------------
          THE ORIGINAL NONREFUNDABLE AMOUNT FROM A PREVIOUS
          TICKET SHALL BE CARRIED FORWARD AS NONREFUNDABLE
          TO ANY EXCHANGED/REISSUED TICKET.
 
  AND - CANCELLATIONS
 
    CHARGE 75 PERCENT.
         NOTE -
          CANCELLATION RULES APPLY PER FARE COMPONENT.
          --------------------------------------------------
          CANCELLATION FEE -
          TRANSACTION MADE -
          1.BEFORE THE DAY OF DEPARTURE OF THE ORIGINALLY
          SCHEDULED FLIGHT - 50PERCENT PER COUPON
          2.ON/AFTER THE DAY OF DEPARTURE OF THE ORIGINALLY
          SCHEDULED FLIGHT - 75PERCENT PER COUPON/ ALSO FOR
          NO-SHOW- 75PERCENT PER COUPON/
          TRANSACTION IS VALIDATED AGAINST THE TICKET
          COUPON/S BEING CANCELLED.
          ---------------------------------------------
          CANCELLATION FEE APPLIES PER EACH CANCELLED FARE
          COMPONENT. THE SUM OF THE CANCELLATION FEES OF
          ALL CANCELLED FARE COMPONENTS WILL BE CHARGED.
          NO FEE DISCOUNT APPLIES TO CHILD/INFANT WITH A
          SEAT. NO FEE APPLIES TO INFANT WITHOUT A SEAT.
          FEE WILL BE SELECTED IN THE CURRENCY OF THE
          COUNTRY OF PRICING UNIT ORIGIN WHEN FILED IN THAT
          CURRENCY AND WILL BE CONVERTED INTO THE CURRENCY
          OF PAYMENT AT THE CURRENT BSR RATE.
          --------------------------------------------------
          FOR A PARTIALLY USED TICKET CALCULATE THE
          DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THE FARE PAID AND THE
          APPLICABLE FARE FOR THE PORTION FLOWN RE-ASSESSED
          ON THE DATE OF THE ORIGINAL ISSUE IN THE SAME OR
          HIGHER RBD/S. UNLESS THE FARE IS NONREFUNDABLE ANY
          CREDIT WILL BE REFUNDED/LESS THE CANCELLATION
          FEE/S IF APPLICABLE.
          --------------------------------------------------
          WHEN RE-PRICING THE FLOWN PORTION -
          THE FARE SELECTED SHALL BE EQUAL TO OR HIGHER
          THAN THE ORIGINAL FARE. THE FARE BREAK POINTS MAY
          NOT BE CHANGED FOR A FULLY FLOWN FARE COMPONENT.
          A FLOWN PORTION AT PUBLIC FARES CAN BE RE-PRICED
          ONLY WITH PUBLIC FARES.
          A FLOWN PORTION AT PRIVATE FARE CAN BE RE-PRICED
          WITH PUBLIC OR QUALIFIED PRIVATE FARES.
          --------------------------------------------------
          WHEN COMBINING DIFFERENT FARES THE PROVISIONS
          WILL APPLY AS FOLLOWS-
          1.THE AMOUNT PAID ON THE NONREFUNDABLE FARE
          COMPONENT WILL NOT BE REFUNDED.
          2.THE AMOUNT PAID ON THE REFUNDABLE FARE
          COMPONENT WILL BE REFUNDED/LESS THE CANCELLATION
          FEE IF APPLICABLE.
          3.THE SUM OF THE CANCELLATION FEES OF ALL
          CANCELLED FARE COMPONENTS WILL BE CHARGED.
          --------------------------------------------------
          THE ORIGINAL NONREFUNDABLE AMOUNT FROM A PREVIOUS
          TICKET SHALL BE CARRIED FORWARD AS NONREFUNDABLE
          TO ANY EXCHANGED/REISSUED TICKET.
          WHERE THE NONREFUNDABLE AMOUNT CARRIED FORWARD
          FROM A PREVIOUS TICKET IS HIGHER THAN THAT BASED
          ON THE PROVISIONS OF THE NEWLY EXCHANGED/REISSUED
          TICKET THAT DIFFERENCE SHALL BE ADDED TO THE
          APPLICABLE CANCELLATION FEE TO BE TAKEN.
          ANY ORIGINAL NONREFUNDABLE TAX AMOUNT CARRIED
          FORWARD WILL NOT BE REFUNDED.
          --------------------------------------------------
          CANCELLATION FEE IS CAPPED UP TO THE REFUNDABLE
          AMOUNT CALCULATED FOR THE FARE PLUS THE
          REFUNDABLE YQ/YR SURCHARGE/S.
    AND -
         NOTE -
          --------------------------------------------------
          TRANSACTIONS ARE ALLOWED WITHIN THE TICKET
          VALIDITY.
          --------------------------------------------------
          CHANGE FEE/S SHALL BE COLLECTED UNDER CP CODE IN
          THE TAX BOX.
          --------------------------------------------------
          TAXES/FEES CONDITIONS-
          1.UNUSED AIRPORT TAXES/ TAXES PAID TO THIRD
          PARTIES MAY BE REFUNDED UNLESS THEY ARE LEGALLY
          NON-REFUNDABLE.
          2.UNUSED YQ/YR CARRIER SURCHARGE/S CANNOT BE
          REFUNDED UNLESS THE FARE IS REFUNDABLE.
          THE REFUNDABLE YQ/YR AMOUNT SHALL BE USED TO
          COVER THE CANCELLATION FEE/S/ IF APPLICABLE.
          UNUSED YQ/YR CARRIER SURCHARGE/S MAY BE REUSED.
          3.AIRLINE SERVICE OB/TS FEE/S CANNOT BE REFUNDED
          UNLESS THERE IS AN INVOLUNTARY REQUEST FOR A
          COMPLETELY UNUSED TICKET.
          4.CP CHANGE FEE/S CANNOT BE REFUNDED OR REUSED.
          -------------------------------------------------
          WAIVERS ----
          1.AUTHORISED BEFORE DEPARTURE IN CASE OF
          REJECTION OF VISA - THE EMBASSY STATEMENT
          REQUIRED.
          2.AUTHORISED IN THE EVENT OF THE DEATH OF THE
          PASSENGER OR FAMILY MEMBER - THE DEATH
          CERTIFICATE REQUIRED.

         NOTE -
          --------------------------------------------------

          --------------------------------------------------
          CHANGE FEE SHALL BE COLLECTED UNDER CP CODE IN

          --------------------------------------------------
          TAXES/FEES CONDITIONS-
          1.UNUSED AIRPORT TAXES/ TAXES PAID TO THIRD

          2.UNUSED YQ/YR CARRIER IMPOSED SURCHARGE/S CANNOT

          THE REFUNDABLE YQ/YR AMOUNT SHALL BE USED TO

Category.Name: PENALTIES
Category._:
FOR NRTOPTRO TYPE FARES
 
  CHANGES
 
    CHARGE EUR 20.00.
         NOTE -
          A CHANGE IS A DATE/FLIGHT/ROUTING/RBD MODIFICATION
          --------------------------------------------------
          CHANGE FEE/CP -
          TRANSACTION MADE -
          1.BEFORE THE DAY OF DEPARTURE OF THE ORIGINALLY
          SCHEDULED FLIGHT - EUR10.00
          2.ON/AFTER THE DAY OF DEPARTURE OF THE ORIGINALLY
          SCHEDULED FLIGHT - EUR20.00 /ALSO FOR NO-SHOW-
          EUR20.00/
          TRANSACTION IS VALIDATED AGAINST THE TICKET
          COUPON/S BEING CHANGED.
          --------------------------------------------------
          WHEN MORE THAN ONE FARE COMPONENT IS BEING
          CHANGED - THE HIGHEST FEE OF ALL CHANGED FARE
          COMPONENTS PER TICKET WILL APPLY.
          NO FEE DISCOUNT APPLIES TO CHILD/INFANT WITH A
          SEAT. NO FEE APPLIES TO INFANT WITHOUT A SEAT.
          FEE WILL APPLY PER PASSENGER/FOR EACH TRANSACTION.
          FEE WILL BE SELECTED IN THE CURRENCY OF THE
          COUNTRY OF PRICING UNIT ORIGIN WHEN FILED IN THAT
          CURRENCY AND WILL BE CONVERTED INTO THE CURRENCY
          OF PAYMENT AT THE CURRENT BSR RATE.
          --------------------------------------------------
          RE-PRICE THE NEW ITINERARY FROM THE POINT OF
          ORIGIN USING RO FARES IN THE SAME OR A HIGHER RBD.
          PUBLIC OR PRIVATE FARES MAY BE USED.
          THE FARE BEING APPLIED MUST COMPLY WITH ALL
          PROVISIONS.
          --------------------------------------------------
          WHEN NO INTERNATIONAL COUPONS REMAIN ALL NEW
          TRAVEL MUST BE DOMESTIC.
          --------------------------------------------------
          CHANGES TO FARE BREAK POINTS ARE PERMITTED.
          A FULLY FLOWN FARE COMPONENT MAY NOT BE RE-PRICED
          TO A FURTHER POINT.
          --------------------------------------------------
          THE REPLACEMENT FARE MUST BE EQUAL OR HIGHER THAN
          PREVIOUS/PER TICKET. IT MAY BE LOWER/EQUAL OR
          HIGHER ONLY WHEN CHANGES ARE MADE TO A FULLY
          UNUSED TICKET AND THE RBD/CONNECTION/STOPOVER AND
          FARE BREAK POINTS ARE KEPT AS ORIGINALLY TICKETED.
          ANY DIFFERENCE WILL BE COLLECTED.
          ANY RESIDUAL FARE AMOUNT WILL BE IGNORED.
          THE APPLICABLE CHANGE FEE/CP WILL BE CHARGED IN
          ADDITION.
          --------------------------------------------------
          1.WHEN CHANGES ARE MADE TO A FULLY UNUSED TICKET-
          RE-PRICE USING THE CURRENT FARES IN EFFECT ON THE
          DATE OF THE TRANSACTION. IF CHANGES DO NOT OCCUR
          ON THE 1ST FARE COMPONENT OF THE JOURNEY ALSO
          RE-PRICE USING HISTORICAL FARES AND SELECT
          WHICHEVER IS LOWER.
          2.WHEN CHANGES ARE MADE TO A PARTIALLY USED TICKET
          RE-PRICE USING THE HISTORICAL FARES IN EFFECT ON
          THE DATE OF THE PREVIOUS ISSUE.
          --------------------------------------------------
          THE ORIGINAL NONREFUNDABLE AMOUNT FROM A PREVIOUS
          TICKET SHALL BE CARRIED FORWARD AS NONREFUNDABLE
          TO ANY EXCHANGED/REISSUED TICKET.
 
  AND - CANCELLATIONS
 
    CHARGE 75 PERCENT.
         NOTE -
          CANCELLATION RULES APPLY PER FARE COMPONENT.
          --------------------------------------------------
          CANCELLATION FEE -
          TRANSACTION MADE -
          1.BEFORE THE DAY OF DEPARTURE OF THE ORIGINALLY
          SCHEDULED FLIGHT - 50PERCENT PER COUPON
          2.ON/AFTER THE DAY OF DEPARTURE OF THE ORIGINALLY
          SCHEDULED FLIGHT - 75PERCENT PER COUPON/ ALSO FOR
          NO-SHOW- 75PERCENT PER COUPON/
          TRANSACTION IS VALIDATED AGAINST THE TICKET
          COUPON/S BEING CANCELLED.
          ---------------------------------------------
          CANCELLATION FEE APPLIES PER EACH CANCELLED FARE
          COMPONENT. THE SUM OF THE CANCELLATION FEES OF
          ALL CANCELLED FARE COMPONENTS WILL BE CHARGED.
          NO FEE DISCOUNT APPLIES TO CHILD/INFANT WITH A
          SEAT. NO FEE APPLIES TO INFANT WITHOUT A SEAT.
          FEE WILL BE SELECTED IN THE CURRENCY OF THE
          COUNTRY OF PRICING UNIT ORIGIN WHEN FILED IN THAT
          CURRENCY AND WILL BE CONVERTED INTO THE CURRENCY
          OF PAYMENT AT THE CURRENT BSR RATE.
          --------------------------------------------------
          FOR A PARTIALLY USED TICKET CALCULATE THE
          DIFFERENCE BETWEEN THE FARE PAID AND THE
          APPLICABLE FARE FOR THE PORTION FLOWN RE-ASSESSED
          ON THE DATE OF THE ORIGINAL ISSUE IN THE SAME OR
          HIGHER RBD/S. UNLESS THE FARE IS NONREFUNDABLE ANY
          CREDIT WILL BE REFUNDED/LESS THE CANCELLATION
          FEE/S IF APPLICABLE.
          --------------------------------------------------
          WHEN RE-PRICING THE FLOWN PORTION -
          THE FARE SELECTED SHALL BE EQUAL TO OR HIGHER
          THAN THE ORIGINAL FARE. THE FARE BREAK POINTS MAY
          NOT BE CHANGED FOR A FULLY FLOWN FARE COMPONENT.
          A FLOWN PORTION AT PUBLIC FARES CAN BE RE-PRICED
          ONLY WITH PUBLIC FARES.
          A FLOWN PORTION AT PRIVATE FARE CAN BE RE-PRICED
          WITH PUBLIC OR QUALIFIED PRIVATE FARES.
          --------------------------------------------------
          WHEN COMBINING DIFFERENT FARES THE PROVISIONS
          WILL APPLY AS FOLLOWS-
          1.THE AMOUNT PAID ON THE NONREFUNDABLE FARE
          COMPONENT WILL NOT BE REFUNDED.
          2.THE AMOUNT PAID ON THE REFUNDABLE FARE
          COMPONENT WILL BE REFUNDED/LESS THE CANCELLATION
          FEE IF APPLICABLE.
          3.THE SUM OF THE CANCELLATION FEES OF ALL
          CANCELLED FARE COMPONENTS WILL BE CHARGED.
          --------------------------------------------------
          THE ORIGINAL NONREFUNDABLE AMOUNT FROM A PREVIOUS
          TICKET SHALL BE CARRIED FORWARD AS NONREFUNDABLE
          TO ANY EXCHANGED/REISSUED TICKET.
          WHERE THE NONREFUNDABLE AMOUNT CARRIED FORWARD
          FROM A PREVIOUS TICKET IS HIGHER THAN THAT BASED
          ON THE PROVISIONS OF THE NEWLY EXCHANGED/REISSUED
          TICKET THAT DIFFERENCE SHALL BE ADDED TO THE
          APPLICABLE CANCELLATION FEE TO BE TAKEN.
          ANY ORIGINAL NONREFUNDABLE TAX AMOUNT CARRIED
          FORWARD WILL NOT BE REFUNDED.
          --------------------------------------------------
          CANCELLATION FEE IS CAPPED UP TO THE REFUNDABLE
          AMOUNT CALCULATED FOR THE FARE PLUS THE
          REFUNDABLE YQ/YR SURCHARGE/S.
    AND -
         NOTE -
          --------------------------------------------------
          TRANSACTIONS ARE ALLOWED WITHIN THE TICKET
          VALIDITY.
          --------------------------------------------------
          CHANGE FEE/S SHALL BE COLLECTED UNDER CP CODE IN
          THE TAX BOX.
          --------------------------------------------------
          TAXES/FEES CONDITIONS-
          1.UNUSED AIRPORT TAXES/ TAXES PAID TO THIRD
          PARTIES MAY BE REFUNDED UNLESS THEY ARE LEGALLY
          NON-REFUNDABLE.
          2.UNUSED YQ/YR CARRIER SURCHARGE/S CANNOT BE
          REFUNDED UNLESS THE FARE IS REFUNDABLE.
          THE REFUNDABLE YQ/YR AMOUNT SHALL BE USED TO
          COVER THE CANCELLATION FEE/S/ IF APPLICABLE.
          UNUSED YQ/YR CARRIER SURCHARGE/S MAY BE REUSED.
          3.AIRLINE SERVICE OB/TS FEE/S CANNOT BE REFUNDED
          UNLESS THERE IS AN INVOLUNTARY REQUEST FOR A
          COMPLETELY UNUSED TICKET.
          4.CP CHANGE FEE/S CANNOT BE REFUNDED OR REUSED.
          -------------------------------------------------
          WAIVERS ----
          1.AUTHORISED BEFORE DEPARTURE IN CASE OF
          REJECTION OF VISA - THE EMBASSY STATEMENT
          REQUIRED.
          2.AUTHORISED IN THE EVENT OF THE DEATH OF THE
          PASSENGER OR FAMILY MEMBER - THE DEATH
          CERTIFICATE REQUIRED.

         NOTE -
          --------------------------------------------------
          TRANSACTIONS ARE ALLOWED WITHIN THE TICKET

          --------------------------------------------------
          CHANGE FEE SHALL BE COLLECTED UNDER CP CODE IN
          THE TAX BOX.
          --------------------------------------------------
          TAXES/FEES CONDITIONS-
          1.UNUSED AIRPORT TAXES/ TAXES PAID TO THIRD
          PARTIES MAY BE REFUNDED UNLESS THEY ARE LEGALLY
          NON-REFUNDABLE.
          2.UNUSED YQ/YR CARRIER IMPOSED SURCHARGE/S CANNOT
          BE REFUNDED UNLESS THE FARE IS REFUNDABLE/ WITH OR

          THE REFUNDABLE YQ/YR AMOUNT SHALL BE USED TO

          3.AIRLINE SERVICE OB/TS FEE/S CANNOT BE REFUNDED
